explication: Archify turns an agent’s typed JSON diagram description into a deterministic, self-contained interactive artifact. The principal workflow is: user or agent supplies IR, the CLI loads and validates it, a diagram renderer lays out SVG/HTML, and the viewer supports grounded search, route/reach tracing, guided stories, and export. Separate branches handle repository-source verification, architecture deltas, and multiple diagram types. The sampled excerpts show renderer, evidence, delta, workflow, lifecycle, preview, and viewer responsibilities; some CLI orchestration is inferred from documented behavior.
